title: Beautiful private boat trip in Sevilla
text: This was without doubt a fantastic trip from start to finish. Paul ( skipper) has a fantastic knowledge of Sevilla and provides superb food and drinks. The boat is beautiful and intimate and comfortable. Paul organises the service for you via WhatsApp so there’s no worries about times and location. Highly recommend this special excursion.
author: pearlzaffy

title: Great Experience on the Guadalquivir
text: What a great way to see Seville from a unique viewpoint!  We met David our captain/guide on the dock and went to our private boat.  We started with some wine while enjoying the sunset over the Guadalquivir.  We left the dock to begin our scenic tour of the river while enjoying a wonderful meal. David was a pleasure and the entire experience was great!
author: GrandTour43023371029

title: A good boat ride!
text: Do not expect lots from this other than a boat ride! We figured this as it is explained clearly but still had met folks who warned us (they were very disappointed which if you expected a lot more makes sense) We went in with a healthy amount of low expectations and enjoyed it. A drink a box of cheese and jamón and a little over an hour cruising up and down the river not so bad! I think operator is learning so hopefully a growing operation in time!
author: Derek_P

title: Family aperitif for birthday
text:
Paul gave us a guided tour with all the history of Seville through the different eras, from the Roman Empire to the triana district, christophe Columbus, Magellan, the universal exhibition...
We were able to admire another way to discover Seville the time passed too quickly.
The wine and tapas were good we had a pleasant time with family. 
Perhaps we will meet Paul another time in the park of the Volcanoes of Auvergne.
author: nicolasgT7499OC

title: Great time for EVJF
text: Great time spent on the boat, lots of tapas choices and David is very friendly, we were able to put our own music while having a beautiful sunset over the river

title: Valentine’s Day boat ride
text: Incredible service, captain David and views! Highly recommend, we was on our own just the two of us it was lovely. Thank you
author: Lauren S

title: We had a sweet, intimate...
text: We had a sweet, intimate (we were 6 people in total) and amazing experience. The captain knew a lot about the culture of Seville, more specifically about the things around the "river". He was attentive and grateful. We definitely recommend it.
author: Pablo_B
